native.lineMetrics: Default Android font metrics; YAML adds 2dp and log output adds 3dp with line-spacing multiplier 1. No fixed line-height scale.
native.focus: Native EditText cursor, selection and keyboard behavior; filters have no drawn focus border. The YAML editor changes from a 1dp outline-role resting stroke to a 2dp primary-role focused stroke. Actions and tabs retain native RippleDrawable feedback without a custom focus ring. Log refresh leaves filter focus intact.
native.feedback: Button elevation is 0; state-list elevation animator is removed. RecyclerView item animator is disabled. ViewPager2 and platform dialogs retain native behavior.
native.previewPolicy: Self-contained HTML/CSS component translations approximate Android at default density and font scale; browser native focus is retained. Previews are not native shipping code or a pixel reproduction contract.
native.rampPolicy: Tonal ramps are synthesized OKLCH visualization metadata, dark to light at source chroma/hue. They are not shipped Android resource values or an expanded authorized palette.
native.scope: All five destinations, shared navigation chrome and app-owned native menus/dialogs use the Technical atlas in day/night modes.

workspace.selectionHighlight: Active primary RGB at alpha 0x33 for YAML and log text.
workspace.sidebarWidth: min(360dp, screenWidthDp / 2 - 36dp), with 24dp end margin; scrollable controls.
workspace.profileChevron: Native 24dp ic_expand_more vector, tinted primary, 8dp compound-drawable gap; not a raster or text glyph.
workspace.editorInput: Native multiline horizontally scrolling EditText; no suggestions, extract UI, fullscreen IME or personalized learning requests. Native text selection and app draft restoration.
workspace.logSnapshot: Pause retains last snapshot; initial read occurs without an existing snapshot. Read failures retain content and show error status. Unchanged text skips replacement; changed text follows the tail only when already at bottom, otherwise restores offset. Filter changes reset to top.
workspace.exportScope: Configuration snapshots current editor contents. Log export reads all retained service/core logs independently of the displayed tail, filter or pause.
workspace.liveControl: Native Switch, checked initially, platform theme tint; no custom thumb or track tokens.
workspace.assets: No new shipping raster assets; profile chevron is native vector XML.

narrative.overview:
A scientific reference atlas expressed through native Android Views. Violet chrome, quiet work areas and aligned facts give technical ShadowQUIC users a readable view of the local engine. Familiar controls and repeated measurement labels carry the character; there is no illustration or ornamental material layer.

This system describes all five shipped destinations: Connection, Proxies, Configuration, Logs and Sessions, together with their shared navigation chrome and app-owned native dialogs. Configuration and Logs extend the same atlas with large YAML and log workspaces; all destinations retain the violet header and lavender tab treatment. The confirmed atlas selection supplies the metaphor; installed native Views supply the tokens and behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Violet hierarchy with teal download and success roles.
Paired upload/download columns with explicit labels.
Flat native controls, thin separators and stable live lists.
Android system typography, tabular measurements and monospace source text.
Distinct local-engine, unavailable, empty and failure states.

rules.name: The Repeated Legend Rule
rules.body: Keep upload on the left in the primary violet role and download on the right in the download teal role. Repeat the words at each measurement group so color is never the sole key.

rules.name: The Figures Stay Put Rule
rules.body: Use tabular figures for changing measurements and preserve identity and alignment during refresh; do not add a decorative number font.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Keep workspaces flat on the shared work surface; use lavender fill for controls, keyed strips and source panes, and separators between diagnostic records.

dos: **Do** use matched light/dark semantic roles from Android resources and keep the header's fixed violet treatment.
**Do** repeat upload/download labels, left/right order and measurement colors at every pair.
**Do** retain tabular figures, native sp text scaling, dp spacing and a minimum 48dp control height.
**Do** distinguish local engine state, remote evidence, missing metrics, zero, empty results and failed requests.
**Do** preserve long destinations, IPv6 notation, filter state and reading position during live updates.
**Do** keep all five destinations and app-owned dialogs on the shared atlas, with monospace reserved for YAML and actual logs.
**Do** preserve editor focus/IME space and log snapshot, filter focus and reading offset during refresh.
**Do** distinguish configuration saving/application and displayed-log filtering/full retained-log export.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce the former green/dark Configuration and Logs treatment or change chrome by destination.
**Don't** substitute color alone for text labels or report unavailable measurements as zero.
**Don't** add decorative cards, illustration or elevation to the flat diagnostic record system.
**Don't** treat synthetic review figures or fixture labels as production content or proof of remote connectivity.
**Don't** spread the editor's focus stroke to filters or invent hover animation and fixed line-height rules absent from the native implementation.
**Don't** discard a retained log snapshot on read failure or let filter/pause alter the full-export scope.
